finding: Women with osteogenesis imperfecta experienced higher rates of pregnancy complications, cesarean deliveries, and adverse neonatal outcomes compared to the general population.
mod_finding: Women with osteogenesis imperfecta had a higher rate of cesarean delivery compared to the general population (68.5% vs 32.7%).
birth_weight: Low birth weight and very low birth weight were higher in neonates born to women with osteogenesis imperfecta.
